description: SPW publishes a country-level synthetic population for Norway under CC BY 4.0, with a public data ZIP, README and contact matrix. The README describes person demographics, household membership, residences, activity sites and daily person-to-site assignments. It cites United Nations Demographic Yearbook households, GPW counts, World Bank templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places. The national dataset could initialise agents for Norwegian infrastructure service-access or emergency-response scenarios. It differs from the separately reviewed metropolitan Oslo MATSim sample, which has a different producer, licence, format and coverage. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this SPW Norway release. A limitation is that SPW activity assignments are synthetic contacts, not observed national travel or evacuation movements. The README does not document routing over roads or ferries, nor utility demand at destinations. No ZIP was downloaded, and location quality and household totals were not independently checked.
